simple.meaning: נַעֲצוּץ (naʻătsûwts) is a Hebrew word meaning “probably a brier ; by implication, a thicket of thorny bushes.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נַעֲצוּץ (H5285) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 7:19, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נַעֲצוּץ (H5285) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נַעֲצוּץ (H5285) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נַעֲצוּץ (naʻătsûwts) / H5285 is traced through Isaiah 7:19, Isaiah 55:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
